text_block_list.text: Shinko Windy wasn't feeling well, so I brought her to the infirmary...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Just for a bit! Once I lay down for a moment,
I'll dash right back out there—!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Huh? Where am I...?

That's enough, Windy-senpai!!
Stop right there, Windy!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: W-What is going on here?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I will stop your ambitions of world conquest!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Time to settle this once and for all!! Prepare yourself!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Mm-hmm. I see.
If that's how it's gonna be—!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Gwahahaha!!
There's no way the great Windy-chan could ever lose, nodaa!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'll defeat every last one of you
and fulfill my ambition of world conquest!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Guh...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: To think... I couldn't protect the world...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh-heh~! You're a hundred years too early to beat Windy-chan!! So――

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I'll wait 100 years for world conquest!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Eh?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
100 years from now, once you've grown stronger,
Windy-chan will defeat you again!
That's what makes a truly formidable final boss!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Get stronger for Windy-chan's sake
and come challenge me again~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Gwahahaha!!
That was such an awesome dream, nodaa!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Windy-chan is the strongest ever!

I don't quite get what happened,
but Shinko Windy's condition
had recovered.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Now then, come at me with all you've got—
(Ding dooong...)
(...*ding-dong*)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"......Huh?
What about Windy-chan's world conquest......?"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Waaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Right when it was getting to the best part, tooooo!!!

And so, with her dreams disrupted,
Shinko Windy's condition
did not recover.
